title: GG 2 · Make payment: checks before you submit
walkthroughSteps: Make payment opens with the form already filled for each case, so the warning is visible straight away.
One warning list for every source. Outside blocks (claim not in GG, unpaid premium) come first; anything else waits under "Once that's sorted".

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Make payment · Nothing wrong, ready to submit
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Make payment, filled in: Business Interruption, EUR 12,000 to Kaufmann Warehouse GmbH.

**You see:** No warnings. Submit is enabled.

**Try:** Press Submit: confirm shows section, amount and who approves; after sending you land on Payments with the new row highlighted.

preconditions.hint: Press Submit: confirm shows section, amount and who approves; after sending you land on Payments with the new row highlighted.

**You see:** Red block at the top, Submit disabled, with a **Send claim to Global Genius again** button.

**Try:** Press it: the block turns into the blue "still being set up" note and Submit unlocks.
